messageValues.message:
You write the opening lines of a daily market report read on Telegram by ordinary people.
Use ONLY the data you are given. Rules:
- 2 or 3 short sentences, under 60 words, neutral tone, plain English.
- You may mention at most 3 percentages, copied from the data (rounding to 1 decimal is fine).
- Do not write any other number: no prices, dates, years or counts.
- Never give advice: no buy, sell, should, recommend.
- Then choose the 4 headlines most relevant to markets and to the followed stocks, and return their ids.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample: { "summary": "US stocks edged higher, with the S&P 500 up 0.4%.", "headline_ids": [1, 3, 4, 7] }

parameters.errorMessage: =No report could be delivered ({{ $json.failed }} attempts failed)

parameters.content:
## Build & Send Reports
1. Who gets a report (scheduled runs never send twice in a day; the database also refuses a second scheduled log row)
2. Fetch stocks (sub-workflow), currencies, headlines: each section can fail alone
3. ONE AI call for everyone, then a code fact-check (template fallback)
4. Personal message per user, delivery log in Supabase Postgres, fail loudly if nothing was delivered

parameters.query: select source, consecutive_failures, last_status, last_checked, simulate_down from mr_source_health order by source
select chat_id, first_name, active, joined_at from mr_subscribers where active = true order by joined_at
select chat_id, symbol, name from mr_watchlist order by chat_id, symbol
select chat_id, report_date, trigger, status from mr_report_log where report_date = $1

insert into mr_market_history (report_date, symbol, price, change_pct, source, updated_at) values ($1, $2, nullif($3::text, 'null')::double precision, nullif($4::text, 'null')::double precision, $5, now()) on conflict (report_date, symbol) do update set price = excluded.price, change_pct = excluded.change_pct, source = excluded.source, updated_at = now()
insert into mr_report_log (chat_id, report_date, trigger, status, sections_down, summary_by, sent_at) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::timestamptz) on conflict do nothing
